title: American-Made Brands: Top Products Still Manufactured in the USA
text:
Discover which brands still manufacture products in the United States, from clothing and footwear to mattresses, cookware, and tools. Learn about American-made options that prioritize domestic materials and factories.
As consumer preferences shift towards domestic production, more shoppers are seeking out products made in the United States. This trend highlights a growing interest in supporting local manufacturing and ensuring higher quality standards.
We rounded up standout American-made brands and identified which products are still manufactured domestically and which ones are imported. In the clothing sector, few brands still manufacture or assemble products in the United States, but these brands continue to make select items here at home.
For example, one brand uses 100% cotton from domestic farms. They have a diamond-shaped gusset that lets you move more freely, and they're one of the few pairs of jeans still made in the U.S. for less than $100. Another provides a classic jean jacket style with denim from Georgia. Inspired by vintage hunting jackets, it provides extra room to move comfortably, and the brass hardware (also crafted in Georgia) elevates the jacket even more.
A third brand uses American-milled denim from Georgia. The Slim Straight fit has a tailored look through the hips and thighs, with a roomy straight leg below the knee. In footwear, few sneaker brands still manufacture shoes in the United States, but New Balance, Danner and Keen produce select styles domestically using American-made materials and even U.S.-based factories. While New Balance manufactures some sneakers in the United States, many of its more affordable styles come from factories overseas.
One model has FuelCell foam cushioning for all-day comfort and better arch support. A suede-and-mesh upper adds breathability, while giving you an athletic look. Another is the lightweight design and unlined leather help reduce sweat buildup. An electrical hazard rating provides extra protection against workplace shocks.
Danner includes waterproof hiking boots made in America. The all-terrain traction and heel lock ensure your feet stay secure on rocky trails, muddy fields and even icy slopes. In the mattress industry, several brands continue to manufacture their products in the United States. These three are known for building mattresses domestically using high-quality materials.
Many bed-in-a-box brands source some of their materials or components from overseas, even though final assembly usually takes place in the United States. One mattress includes a lumbar zone that works to keep your spine properly aligned, no matter what position you sleep in. Its pillow-top design brings a softer feel, and the coil-and-foam construction gives you and your partner long-lasting support. Each mattress is made to order and delivered fully expanded with white-glove service.
Another can be customized to your liking with four firmness options. The award-winning bed combines gel foam and coils to balance support and comfort. A breathable cover also lets you sleep cooler. A third uses only certified organic materials.
The zippered design lets you personalize the feel by adding or removing stuffing as needed. Customers can also exchange layers during the first 100 days. In cookware, these brands continue to manufacture select items in the United States, producing everything from stainless steel pots and pans to cast-iron skillets. Though extremely popular and affordable, other brands manufacture much of their cookware overseas.
While these products aren't American-made, they're still known for their reliability and durability. One versatile build and included lid can sear, steam and simmer all your favorite foods. It even safely goes in the oven, letting you move seamlessly from the stovetop to the table. Another is the Lodge Dutch oven.
The lid doubles as a frying pan or fits over the pot when you want to bake, roast or steam. Cast iron construction distributes heat evenly, reducing hot spots that can burn your food. For tools, if you're shopping for a new hammer or multi-tool, these particular brands continue to manufacture many of their products in the United States. These popular tool brands manufacture many of their products overseas.
While they aren't American-made, they're still widely used and trusted. One brand offers an American-made, ultra-durable option that's easy to hold. Forged from a single, solid piece of steel, you get no breaking points, ensuring the tool lasts longer. Plus, the grip is built to absorb shock as you work.
Another features more than a dozen tools in one compact device that fits in your pocket. Pack a pair of needle-nose pliers, scissors, knives and a bottle opener, and prepare for any project or situation. A third has a pair of New England nose pliers, a pair of diagonal cutting pliers, needle nose pliers and a wire stripper. You also receive a flat head and Phillips-head screwdriver with comfortable handles for a steady grip.
The article is written by Christopher Murray, a commerce writer for Fox News who specializes in topics like outdoor gear, DIY projects, grills, pet products and auto must-haves
